## Summary

Recover original448421e viewer code-entry transitions.

```text
open code → fade toolbar controls separately; delete card/detail previews after fade
Back → fresh page one; source sort x616.55
local list → sort x501.6
async read/cancel → dispose old pending panes before rebuilding; invalidate stale request
```

Stacked on #90.

## Evidence

- **Before:** code entry faded one content group and retained its preview panes.
  **After:** model/browser checks verify separate queues, preview disposal, fresh page-one return, source control ordering and one-time prompt clearing.
- Formatting, TypeScript,560 rule/parser tests (6,543 assertions), production build and all14 affected native/mock browser cases pass (2.1minutes), without skips. Existing stalled crypto cancellation, persistence, pane ownership and in-game editing remain verified. Captures inspected.
- Controller/pane model match original448421e. Decompiled small/detail entry, ReturnToViewTanksFromSearch, code submission and focus handlers checked. Prior loading cleanup, description callbacks and signed8.8 alpha corrections retained.
- Five model cases also protect hidden-control deferral, delayed input flags and the source direct-Back delete-on-requeue quirk. Async Web Crypto cleanup is an explicit browser lifetime adapter; it preserves fresh results without changing direct Back semantics.
- Following original navigation/hover/rejection/save/profile checkpoints, the visible mock code-input backdrop difference and synchronized original-runtime comparison remain outstanding. Full viewer/game parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the previous whole-content code-entry transition.

**Blast Radius:** viewer

Code-entry pane/control lifetimes, cancellation and sort registration. No simulation, profile, generated data or media changes.

output.body:
## Summary

Restore the remaining original47 stage and workspace behavior.

```text
stage artwork exceeds bounds → clip without scrolling the fixed origin
primary workspace press → close Enemy Info, retain manual values
secondary press → keep Enemy Info open
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** two mock regressions fail: Enemy Info remains open, and stage-space unexpectedly scrolls to(40,40).
  **After:** native/mock viewer offsets stay(0,0), including an oversized-child scroll attempt; primary dismissal and manual values on reopen pass.
- Formatting, TypeScript,555 rule/parser tests (6,518 assertions), production build and all14 affected native/mock browser cases pass (1.8minutes), without skips. Creator transforms/undo, stats/confirmation/save, dialog text/codes/focus and local viewer routing remain verified. Captures inspected.
- Production changes are the original two overflow:clip assignments and one workspace dismissal call. Decompiled _‑2S invokes _‑Ua when Enemy Stats is open.
- The independent raw-byte audit and production raster probes confirm all21 unique dialog button states contain only EditText and produce no static raster. The omitted cache loop is intentionally inert; labels remain in the existing text layer.
- The68-file audit accounts for original47 runtime recovery once its PR stack lands. Later viewer/profile fixes and controlled original-runtime comparison remain outstanding; full recreation parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores scrollable stage wrappers and persistent Enemy Info on workspace presses.

**Blast Radius:** stage

Shared stage containment and creator panel dismissal. No simulation, profile, generated data or media changes.
